label: prf:categorical-dirac-operator-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical Dirac operator
html:
The proof strategy is constructive. We explicitly define the operator D_q = q^{-1} \nabla + (1-q^{-1}) \iota_\xi \nabla and verify that it satisfies the defining properties of the categorical Dirac operator.

\nabla \colon A \to \Omega^1(A) is part of the categorical connection data. \iota_\xi \colon \Omega^1(A) \to A is the interior product with the Reeb derivation, a morphism in \mathbf{C}. Composing \nabla \circ \iota_\xi with \nabla gives the vertical component \iota_\xi \nabla \colon A \to \Omega^1(A). The scalars q^{-1} and (1 - q^{-1}) act via the substrate parameter, and R-linear combinations of morphisms exist in any R-linear category. The composite \mathcal{D}_\nabla is therefore a morphism.
